svg.title: Relations as a module over the target prime field
svg.desc: Project to the cyclic order-n component before interpreting factor-base entries as logarithms.
svg.text: Relations as a module over the target prime field
Project to the cyclic order-n component before interpreting factor-base entries as logarithms.
Assume a retraction ρ : G → Gₙ with ρ(P)=P; set Fⱼ=ρ(Bⱼ) for ambient factor-base elements Bⱼ.
Summation polynomials and a lift/sign check
Required: wᵀb ≠ 0 modulo n. Rank and denominator checks remain necessary after relation collection.
Example projector when #G=hn and gcd(h,n)=1: ρ=[h⁻¹ mod n]∘[h]. General primary decompositions require their own projector.
